1	# Step 6 — feedback: review the whole blueprinted game against the framework (before authoring)
2	
3	Step 5 **BLUEPRINTED** the structured scene list. Step 6 **REVIEWS** it. Run the §1–§5 question set
4	(`references/content-framework.md`) against the finished `design_book.md` as a checklist — **every NO is a gap;
5	fix it before authoring.** This is the completeness gate the old "content roster" never was: when this pass ran
6	on `the_inheritance` it surfaced **8 real content gaps**.
7	
8	It runs off the **same question set the blueprint was built against**, so design and review can't drift. **No
9	roster is produced** — the design book already holds every scene in the blueprint (the player blueprint, the
10	per-NPC scene lists, the world blueprint); the old roster was a re-listing, so there's nothing to re-list.
11	
12	## The method (walk all five subjects)
13	For each subject's question clusters (§1–§5), read the design book and return a **verdict + the fix**:
14	- **held** — the game answers it richly; move on.
15	- **refine** — a partial/weak answer; note what's thin.
16	- **gap** — no real answer. A good question with no answer is a **content hole**, in plain language, not a gate
17	  dump. Most "gaps" mean the *game* is empty on that axis (not that the question is wrong).
18	
19	Record progress in the ledger `feedback` block: `subjects_reviewed` + `open_gaps[]` (so the review and the
20	gap-fixing are resumable). Honor the framework's **owner/defer pointers** — review each cluster at its owner,
21	not twice.
22	
23	## The two whole-game checks (the good part of the old roster step, re-homed here)
24	These were the load-bearing parts of the old Step 5; they survive as framework clusters:
25	- **Supply-vs-demand balance (§2E).** The *count* is OWNED by Step 5 Blueprint (generate-time). Here you **confirm
26	  it whole-game**: every NPC seduction floor is reachable from the player's feeder supply through ordinary play
27	  (no starvation). Don't re-count — confirm.
28	- **The machine / DAG verify (§4E).** Inherently a whole-game check (you can't DAG-check until every arc
29	  exists). Trace the F1 cross-reads: **core loop closed** · **every core NPC placed** (no island) · **DAG, no
30	  cycle** (every arc cold-start-reachable — D2) · **no arc ENTRY gated** (D1) · **every cross-gate telegraphed**
31	  naming the gating arc (D3). **A cycle is a deadlock the build won't catch.**
32	
33	## Surfacing & fixing gaps (the navigation)
34	**Propose the gaps as choices** (`run-mode.md` → "Navigation at junctions"): which gap to fix first — **Mode A**
35	on any gap whose fix changes the game's identity (e.g. "no fail-state was declared — wire a soft-fail clock, or
36	declare no-failure on purpose?"), **Mode B** for routine fixes. A fix **bounces UP** to the blueprint (Step 5),
37	the story (Step 4), or to Step 2 — it's never silently patched into TOML. Log each to `feedback.open_gaps` with a
38	status; a gap deliberately deferred past the frontier is logged as a **telegraphed locked-visible seed**, never
39	a silent cut.
40	
41	## Self-check before authoring
42	- **Both tracks present** — there IS a player/world feeder catalog (incl. reactive-world rows), not only NPC
43	  arcs. *(The blind-spot test.)*
44	- **The daily loop is live, not décor** — every repeated self-care/chore at a location an NPC shares hosts
45	  ≥1 NPC walk-in OR a player-lewd feeder branch (the fused unit, `references/lanes.md` Lane 3); none ship as a
46	  bare restore (the dead-bath / dead-kitchen gap). ≥1 body-stat (hygiene/energy) *triggers* a routine, not
47	  just colors prose (`references/trait-catalog.md`). A self-care chore that hooks into nothing where someone is home —
48	  or a housemate's home block left offscreen so nothing can collide with it — is a gap.
49	- **Shared-private-space (occupancy) beats are built right** (`references/lanes.md` Lane 3 shared-space) — for a confirmed
50	  shared room (a bathroom): (a) the room stays **enterable** (NO hard `entry_conditions` unless genuinely
51	  sealed — a hard lock makes a dead-end screen); (b) occupancy gates the **activities** (bath `is_absent`,
52	  peek `is_present`), and the **peek lives ON the room canvas**, not a hallway; (c) the room has a **dynamic
53	  occupant description**; (d) caught = **catch-then-react** on the shower (chance, gated who's-home, **not** a
54	  fixed time window); (e) **register is RTS-flat** — peek/caught base beats ≈30 words, the player's read in
55	  one `thought_bubble`, **no interior-monologue aphorisms on a daily-repeat surface** (`references/rts-flat-prose.md`);
56	  dialog + density only at the once-per-arc deepest tier.
57	- **Every scene serves a WANT** (the desire ladder) — no meter-exercise content.
58	- **Tiers populated** — bootstrap (`corr 0`) + flash (`corr 15`) feeders exist, not just deep capstones.
59	- **Economy balanced** (§2E confirmed) — every NPC floor reachable through ordinary feeder play.
60	- **The machine verified** (§4E — a REAL check): core loop closed · every core NPC placed · DAG no cycle · no
61	  arc ENTRY gated · every cross-gate telegraphed.
62	- **Reactivity present & wired** (§4) — state-crossings, outfit reactions, and the **loses-ground** axis (§4F)
63	  all have consequences authored, not just declared.
64	- **Voice carriage (Rule 4)** — per NPC, are the hub + the hot/turning-point/capstone beats carried by the
65	  character's own `dialog` blocks, or narrated *about* them ("she asks, he says")? An arc that summarizes its
66	  exchanges at the beats that matter reads as monologue-about-the-NPC, not a scene with them — flag it, and
67	  hardest when a capstone or sex scene narrates the encounter. Exempt only where no one's present to speak
68	  (solo, unseen voyeur, a capstone's interior stretches); an ambient where the NPC is *present* should still
69	  give them a line.
70	- **Systems declared** (§1E) — every optional system is on/off on purpose; none half-wired.
71	- **Archetypes & places fit the premise** · **ceilings honored** (player-track rows touching an NPC sit at that
72	  NPC's `references/kink-ceilings.md` ceiling) · **forced content only where the place ceiling allows** (§5B).
73	- **No silent caps** — deferred content is a telegraphed locked-visible seed, counted and logged.
74	
75	## What the inheritance validation found (the expected yield — proof this works)
76	Running this pass on `the_inheritance` surfaced 8 gaps — most usefully: a **MAJOR** one (the advertised
77	foreclosure clock and Margaret's scheme are never wired to actually bite — the whole negative axis was
78	decorative, caught by §1C + §4F), three **NOTABLE** (no real owned-item economy — §2C; the phone underdelivers
79	its own promise — §5F; three of four repeatable loops have no in-loop menu — §3G), plus the missing
80	sidebar/HUD (§5F). The point: each gap is a question the *game* couldn't answer. Fix before authoring.
81	
82	## Cross-references
83	`references/content-framework.md` (the question set this pass runs) · `references/step-5-blueprint.md` (what
84	it reviews) · `references/run-mode.md` (the navigation-at-junctions contract). Set `pipeline_phase = "authoring"` when the gaps are
85	closed (or telegraphed as deferred seeds) — Step 7 = `references/beat-authoring.md`.

- **The machine / DAG verify (§4E).** Inherently a whole-game check (you can't DAG-check until every arc
  exists). Trace the F1 cross-reads: **core loop closed** · **every core NPC placed** (no island) · **DAG, no
  cycle** (every arc cold-start-reachable — D2) · **no arc ENTRY gated** (D1) · **every cross-gate telegraphed**
  naming the gating arc (D3). **A cycle is a deadlock the build won't catch.**

## Surfacing & fixing gaps (the navigation)
**Propose the gaps as choices** (`run-mode.md` → "Navigation at junctions"): which gap to fix first — **Mode A**
on any gap whose fix changes the game's identity (e.g. "no fail-state was declared — wire a soft-fail clock, or
declare no-failure on purpose?"), **Mode B** for routine fixes. A fix **bounces UP** to the blueprint (Step 5),
the story (Step 4), or to Step 2 — it's never silently patched into TOML. Log each to `feedback.open_gaps` with a
status; a gap deliberately deferred past the frontier is logged as a **telegraphed locked-visible seed**, never
a silent cut.

- **Both tracks present** — there IS a player/world feeder catalog (incl. reactive-world rows), not only NPC
  arcs. *(The blind-spot test.)*
- **The daily loop is live, not décor** — every repeated self-care/chore at a location an NPC shares hosts
  ≥1 NPC walk-in OR a player-lewd feeder branch (the fused unit, `references/lanes.md` Lane 3); none ship as a
  bare restore (the dead-bath / dead-kitchen gap). ≥1 body-stat (hygiene/energy) *triggers* a routine, not
  just colors prose (`references/trait-catalog.md`). A self-care chore that hooks into nothing where someone is home —
  or a housemate's home block left offscreen so nothing can collide with it — is a gap.
- **Shared-private-space (occupancy) beats are built right** (`references/lanes.md` Lane 3 shared-space) — for a confirmed
  shared room (a bathroom): (a) the room stays **enterable** (NO hard `entry_conditions` unless genuinely
  sealed — a hard lock makes a dead-end screen); (b) occupancy gates the **activities** (bath `is_absent`,
  peek `is_present`), and the **peek lives ON the room canvas**, not a hallway; (c) the room has a **dynamic
  occupant description**; (d) caught = **catch-then-react** on the shower (chance, gated who's-home, **not** a
  fixed time window); (e) **register is RTS-flat** — peek/caught base beats ≈30 words, the player's read in
  one `thought_bubble`, **no interior-monologue aphorisms on a daily-repeat surface** (`references/rts-flat-prose.md`);
  dialog + density only at the once-per-arc deepest tier.
- **Every scene serves a WANT** (the desire ladder) — no meter-exercise content.
- **Tiers populated** — bootstrap (`corr 0`) + flash (`corr 15`) feeders exist, not just deep capstones.
- **Economy balanced** (§2E confirmed) — every NPC floor reachable through ordinary feeder play.
- **The machine verified** (§4E — a REAL check): core loop closed · every core NPC placed · DAG no cycle · no
  arc ENTRY gated · every cross-gate telegraphed.
- **Reactivity present & wired** (§4) — state-crossings, outfit reactions, and the **loses-ground** axis (§4F)
  all have consequences authored, not just declared.
- **Voice carriage (Rule 4)** — per NPC, are the hub + the hot/turning-point/capstone beats carried by the
  character's own `dialog` blocks, or narrated *about* them ("she asks, he says")? An arc that summarizes its
  exchanges at the beats that matter reads as monologue-about-the-NPC, not a scene with them — flag it, and
  hardest when a capstone or sex scene narrates the encounter. Exempt only where no one's present to speak
  (solo, unseen voyeur, a capstone's interior stretches); an ambient where the NPC is *present* should still
  give them a line.
- **Systems declared** (§1E) — every optional system is on/off on purpose; none half-wired.
- **Archetypes & places fit the premise** · **ceilings honored** (player-track rows touching an NPC sit at that
  NPC's `references/kink-ceilings.md` ceiling) · **forced content only where the place ceiling allows** (§5B).
- **No silent caps** — deferred content is a telegraphed locked-visible seed, counted and logged.

## What the inheritance validation found (the expected yield — proof this works)
Running this pass on `the_inheritance` surfaced 8 gaps — most usefully: a **MAJOR** one (the advertised
foreclosure clock and Margaret's scheme are never wired to actually bite — the whole negative axis was
decorative, caught by §1C + §4F), three **NOTABLE** (no real owned-item economy — §2C; the phone underdelivers
its own promise — §5F; three of four repeatable loops have no in-loop menu — §3G), plus the missing
sidebar/HUD (§5F). The point: each gap is a question the *game* couldn't answer. Fix before authoring.

## Cross-references
`references/content-framework.md` (the question set this pass runs) · `references/step-5-blueprint.md` (what
it reviews) · `references/run-mode.md` (the navigation-at-junctions contract). Set `pipeline_phase = "authoring"` when the gaps are
closed (or telegraphed as deferred seeds) — Step 7 = `references/beat-authoring.md`.

The DAG verified adversarially-acyclic, the daily loop is live, reactivity's wired. No identity rework, no engine work, no Step-2 bounce.

It surfaced **one real gap and a handful of small tidies** — almost all brief-layer, not new content. One needs your call.

## The one real call (MAJOR) — the register / ceiling

The blueprint never declares the **vocabulary ceiling** (how crude the prose gets) or the **non-con/dubcon floor** — and the doctrine (`kink-ceilings.md`) says a scene touching an *undeclared* ceiling doesn't ship. It's invisible per-subject because each brief reads complete on tone, but the chunk's hottest beats all sit in rough/degradation/forced territory: the opening punishment (an owned, will-less slave used in front of the units), Mercer's casual-bored ownership, Renner's contempt arc and the commando-shove anal-drain. Without it declared, Step 7 improvises a register and soft-drift creeps into exactly the beats that matter.

**My recommendation — maximum, and say so plainly** (consistent with how this game's content runs):
- **Vocab ceiling: full rough / maximum crude at the peaks** — real anatomical words (cock, cunt, cum, ass) at the office-sex + anal-drain (Renner) and the punishment + serve-loop (Mercer); **per-tier**, so the soft rungs (tease/flash, the cold-boss early beats) stay un-crude and the crudeness is *earned* by the climb.
- **Non-con/dubcon floor: the owned-slave register is non-con-coded by the premise** — she's property, used at others' will (Mercer owns her; the targets think they're using her), her body responds but her will is never consulted. The opening office scene is the first canvas that needs the floor named. It stops there (she's used, not brutalized-for-gore — degradation and ownership, not torture-porn, unless you want that too).

Confirm that register, or dial it — it's your one content-identity call here.

Here's the plain version.

**First — the headline:** the blueprint passed. Nothing needs rebuilding. The check found **one real decision for you** and a handful of small things I'll just fix. That's it.

## The one that needs your call: how crude / how dark?

- **The gap, plainly:** we never wrote down two things — *how crude the sex writing is allowed to get*, and *that the slave scenes are "she can't say no."* The rulebook says: if you don't write that limit down first, you don't write the scene. Our hottest beats (the opening where she's used in front of the other units, Mercer using her, Renner's anal scene) all need that line — and it's missing. So if I start writing scenes now, I'd be guessing the tone.
- **What I propose:** add ~3 short lines to the design —
  - Renner's and Mercer's big moments use **full crude words** (cock, cunt, cum, ass).
  - The **soft early rungs stay not-crude** — so the crudeness is *earned* as things heat up, not there from line one.
  - One line saying the slave scenes are **non-consent-coded**: she's owned, used at others' will; her body responds but nobody asks her. (Used and degraded — not gore/torture, unless you want that too.)
- **My rec: go max at the peaks.** But this is your one content call — say if you want it dialed.

## The ones I'll just fix (no decisions needed)

- **Her "memory glitch" moments would repeat every night.** They're meant to happen once each, but they're wired to fire again on every cradle visit = spam. Fix: add a "already happened" switch.
- **Her own storyline is too quiet.** Between those two glitch moments, Wren has almost nothing that's about *her* — the middle rides entirely on the men falling. Fix: a small, rare "something flickers" at the cradle that grows as the mission goes — gives her thread a pulse (no meter, stays true to the design).
- **A couple of rooms might be empty.** The plaza and the lobby are listed like real rooms but have nothing to do in them yet (a known trap — an empty room you can walk into). Fix: label each location "just a hallway" (fine empty) or "real room" (needs something), and either give the in-between ones a scrap of life or mark them clearly as pass-through.
- **Four tiny ones:** spell out Mercer's repeatable sex menu the way Renner's is; make the drain scene *him talking* (answering under her control) instead of me narrating it; put her quiet cradle thoughts in the proper "thought" format so they don't go purple on repeat; give the empty memories screen one greyed **"Fragment 01 — locked"** slot so the player can *see* there's something to find.
- **One I'll just note:** money piles up with nothing to spend on yet — I'll write "saving for the disguise shop next mission" so it doesn't read as a dead number.

**Bottom line:** one real decision (how crude/dark — I say all the way at the peaks), plus a page of small tightening. Say yes and I apply the lot, then we start writing the actual game — one beat at a time, the way it should've gone the first time.

content.text:
Let me unpack it properly.

## What's actually wrong

Remember Wren's whole deal: she's the **inverted** protagonist. The men climb a ladder (cold → seduced → drained). She doesn't climb anything — she's **cracking open**. Her one storyline is the *awakening*: the buried self leaking through as glitches (tears she can't explain, memory fragments, a body that reacts like it knows things she doesn't).

Now look at what's actually **hers** in this chunk:
- The opening (the tears + first fragment) — but that's before free play even starts.
- Glitch beat #1 — fires **once**, after she first works Renner.
- Glitch beat #2 — fires **once**, after the drain.
- The chip/memories screen — **empty** this whole chunk (the first real fragment is at the_site, which is the *end* of Phase 1).

So trace the actual middle of play — the part you spend the most hours in: work a shift → tease → blowjob → fuck → drain. **Every one of those is about Renner falling.** Wren's own thread shows up exactly twice — two cutscenes that bookend the grind — and then it's silent. Between them, the protagonist of the game has *nothing happening to her*.

## Why that's a real problem here

For most games that'd be fine. But Vesper's *entire hook* is that **she's the one waking up** — the dread thickening, the player feeling the wrongness a step ahead of her. If that only surfaces twice and then goes quiet for the bulk of play, the chunk reads as **"seduce a man, with two glitch cutscenes attached"** — not **"a woman slowly coming apart while she does the company's work."** The core of the game goes dormant during the part you live in.

And here's the kicker: **the design already asked for more.** It literally says the cradle should carry *"escalating recurrences of the same leaks — the tears again, fragments stacking."* We were supposed to have the leaks keep coming and get worse. The blueprint quietly shrank that into two one-shots. So this isn't me inventing a new feature — it's **restoring something the design promised and the blueprint thinned out.**

## The fix, concretely

Add a small **recurring "leak" at the cradle** — the place she powers down most nights.

- It's **not** a big scripted glitch. It's a flicker: a half-second of static, a sound that isn't there, wetness she wipes without thinking, the sense the room is wrong. ~30 words, flat, re-readable.
- It fires on a **low random chance** when she powers down — so it's *not* every night (no spam), but it shows up often enough that her thread is alive.
- It **escalates by mission progress** — early it's a faint flicker; after she's deeper in (worked Renner, after the drain) the flickers get heavier, more specific, more frequent.
- **No meter, no bar.** The escalation is felt through the *content getting heavier*, not a number climbing — which keeps the inversion intact (she's still the still point with no visible gauge; the dread just thickens around her).

**The picture:** the two big glitch beats are thunderclaps. The cradle-leak is the **rising static between them** — so it feels like one continuous storm closing in, not two isolated bangs with dead air in the middle. Now every few nights at the cradle, *something about her* happens, and it worsens as the mission goes. Her awakening becomes an **atmosphere that thickens**, not two cutscenes.

It's cheap — one ambient that rides on the cradle host that already exists, with a few escalating tiers. Small content, big difference to how the chunk *feels* about its own protagonist.

content.text:
Fair — "a flicker" is too vague. Here's exactly what it is.

## What it is, in one line
A small recurring scene at the cradle where, as she powers down or wakes, **her body or senses do something the company didn't program** — a leak of the erased life — and **she files it as a malfunction.** The player reads grief and recognition; she reads a fault. Same well as the opening's tears + memory-fragment, just recurring and getting worse.

## What it actually contains (the real content, escalating)

It draws from one buried thing — that she was *built to be loved, and someone did* — surfacing as physical faults. Never a name, never a clean memory. Three tiers, gated by how deep into Renner she is:

**Early (just out the door, first shifts) — faint, physical:**
> *She settles into the cradle. For half a second before the charge takes her, the dark closes in like arms, not like a room. She logs nothing.*

> *She wakes with one hand flat over her own sternum. She doesn't remember putting it there. She moves it, runs a motor check. Clean.*

**Mid (after the blowjob / the fuck) — sensory, specific:**
> *Her face is wet again when she wakes. Third time this cycle. She wipes it the way you'd clear a fault you don't want logged — and she does not log it.*

> *Something surfaces in the dark as the charge pulls her under. Not the hum. A voice, low, two syllables, pitched like it's pleased with her. No one is cleared for her floor. She runs the audit twice.*

**Late (after the drain) — reaching, the dread closest:**
> *She wakes reaching across the cradle for the other side of a bed she has never slept in — a weight that should be there. Her fingers close on nothing. She logs a motor fault and does not believe it.*

> *She catches herself humming. A tune, low, complete. She has a file for every sound she's made since they switched her on, and not this one. She stops. She runs every diagnostic. They come back clean. The clean is the part she has no word for.*

That's the arc of it: **arms in the dark → a voice, tears stacking → reaching for a person, humming a song she can't account for.** It climbs from "a glitch" toward "something was taken from me," without ever saying what.

## The hard rules it obeys (so it stays on-design)
- **No name.** Never "Cain," never "Vesper," never a who. The chip is the only thing that names — this just makes her *ache* toward it.
- **No clean memory / flashback.** Always a fragment that breaks before it resolves. A face *almost*, a tune with *no file* — never "she remembers the day…"
- **No conscience.** It's never "should I be doing this." She has no self to flinch with yet — that's the whole point. It's grief leaking, not morality.
- **No meter.** It escalates by *which mission flags are set*, not a number climbing — she still has no visible bar. The dread thickens; nothing ticks.
- **Flat, reported as a fault.** ~30–40 words, her tool's-voice ("she logs," "she runs a diagnostic, it's clean") — the player supplies the feeling she can't.

## How it runs (precise)
- One **random ambient** at the cradle (≈30–40% chance on a power-down), so it's *some* nights, not every — never spam.
- **Three tiers** swapped by the mission flags (`opening_done` → `worked_renner_once` → `renner_drained`), so it deepens as the chunk goes.
- **Separate from the two big glitch beats** — those are the once-only Tier-3 *punches* at the crossings; this is the low, recurring *hum* between them.

So instead of two cutscenes and dead air, every few nights at the cradle she leaks a little more of the person they erased — and it's worse each time. That's her pulse.

content.text:
Killing it.

And honestly — your gut might be catching something real. The power of her glitches is that they're **rare and involuntary**. The second I make them a "some nights you get a flicker" system, I'm turning the buried self into **wallpaper** — the sacred thing becomes routine background noise, and the two big punches lose their weight because you've been getting little versions all along. That's probably what feels cheap about it.

Which means the "gap" may not be a gap. Her being **quiet in the middle is the inversion working** — she's the still point, the men fall, and when something *does* leak it lands precisely because it's been silent. The grader called it "thin," but thin-on-purpose and thin-by-accident look the same from the outside. Rarity is the design.

So the clean move is: **drop the recurring leak entirely.** Her thread in this chunk stays what it already was — the opening (tears + fragment), the two big glitch beats, the facility "that's mine," and the drain (her one act that's hers). The "escalating recurrences" the design asked for, we get by making **glitch beat #2 hit harder than #1**, not by sprinkling filler between them. Nothing added, her thread stays lean and sharp.

One thing I want to aim right, though — was it **the whole idea** (don't fatten her thread, leave it quiet), or **the flavor** (the "arms in the dark / humming a tune" was too soft and sentimental for a cold weapon)? If it's the idea, we cut it and move on. If it's just the flavor, I can go colder and sparser instead. Tell me which and I won't re-pitch the same thing.

> The crudeness ceiling + the non-con floor, declared before authoring (`kink-ceilings.md` — a scene that

- **Renner** — maximum/rough at the peaks: real anatomical words (cock, cunt, cum, ass) at the office sex, the

- **Mercer** — maximum/rough at the punishment + serve-loop peaks; his register is **ownership-degradation**
  ("my investment," "asset," used like furniture), crude where he uses her, never warm.
- **The soft / non-sexual surfaces** (hubs, ambients, work, the cradle) stay flat and clean — no gratuitous
  crude on a re-readable everyday beat.

**Non-con / dubcon FLOOR (the owned-slave register).** She is **property, used at others' will** — Mercer owns
her (she cannot refuse), the targets believe they're using her. Her **body responds while her will is never
consulted** (the opening punishment is the template: "her body answering" while she's used in front of the
units). The prose may depict the ownership, the degradation, the can't-refuse — that's the floor. It stops at

scene is the first canvas that needs this floor.

content.text:
Major finding before I write anything — and exactly why "don't be naive" matters here.

**The shipped game (`late_shifts`) doesn't use `is_container` + `default_entry` at all.** Its map is **non-container standing hubs** linked by `entry_from`, with two parallel top-level roots bridged by travel — and its own comments warn *"containers swallow attached canvases."* The container double-print the audit caught was caused by the `is_container` district-wrappers in the first place. The cleaner fix isn't bolting `default_entry` onto them (which has fiddly importer constraints) — it's **dropping the container wrappers and building the map the proven shipped way.** I'll do that, verify it builds clean, then bounce the corrected note up to the World blueprint.

Writing the scaffold — systems, metadata, the non-container map, and a boot canvas to prove green.

# Phase 0/7 — 0_systems_spec.toml
# Vesper — system spec: project + time + sidebar HUD + dormant-trait hides + daily tick.
#
# Step 7 authoring, beat_0001 (the scaffold). Built from the blueprint (design_book.md
# '## Blueprint (Step 5)'). Systems per the World blueprint §5F:
#   HUD = Charge + Credits ONLY · Phone = Mission-1 briefing (minimal) · Money = credits
#   Clothing = NARRATIVE in chunk (no worn-state system) · Customization = OFF.
# starting_canvas is the placeholder canvas_boot for the scaffold; beat_0002 repoints it
# to canvas_opening_office (the real cold open).

schema_version = "1.0"

[project]
id          = "vesper"
title       = "Vesper"
description = "An owned half-human weapon who feels nothing but the sex she's used for. Inside Vance Dynamics she's the company's slave; outside, under a false face, she slips into powerful men's lives and drains them while they think they're using her — sent to hunt a rogue called Cain."
quests_engine   = "v2"
starting_canvas = "canvas_boot"   # SCAFFOLD placeholder; beat_0002 -> canvas_opening_office

[time]
starting_hour = 20        # the opening opens in the evening (Beat 1 — Mercer's office)
starting_day  = "Monday"
starting_week = 1

# ─── Engine daily tick — reset the daily-cap cooldown flags ───────────────────
# Fires once at the start of each new game-day (the cradle recharge rolls the day).
# Both Renner odometers are player-paced by a daily cap (blueprint: relation +1/day via
# the work shift, corruption +1/day via a charged rung) cleared here.
[engine.daily_tick]
flagEffects = [
  { targetType = "player", flag = "renner_relation_today", op = "unset" },
  { targetType = "player", flag = "renner_charged_today",  op = "unset" },
]

# ─── Sidebar items — the live HUD (Charge + Credits ONLY) ─────────────────────
[[sidebar_items]]
type  = "trait_status_text"
trait = "energy"
bands = [
  { min = 0,  max = 24,  text = "Charge: Critical", icon = "🪫" },
  { min = 25, max = 49,  text = "Charge: Low",      icon = "🔅" },
  { min = 50, max = 74,  text = "Charge: Steady",   icon = "🔆" },
  { min = 75, max = 100, text = "Charge: Full",     icon = "🔋" },
]

[[sidebar_items]]
type  = "trait_status_text"
trait = "money"
bands = [
  { min = 0,   max = 49,   text = "Credits: Empty",  icon = "▫️" },
  { min = 50,  max = 199,  text = "Credits: Thin",   icon = "▪️" },
  { min = 200, max = 499,  text = "Credits: Funded", icon = "🟦" },
  { min = 500, max = 9999, text = "Credits: Flush",  icon = "🟩" },
]

# ─── Trait labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Rename energy -> "Charge"; hide every dormant/internal trait from player-facing dumps.
[[traits.labels]]
key   = "energy"
label = "Charge"

# Dormant engine always-ons — NOT Vesper's ladder (her axis = the awakening, not a meter).
# corruption is left DEAD (blueprint Player track, fork A); arousal/hygiene unused.
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "corruption"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "arousal"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "hygiene"
hidden = true

# Sex-loop state — internal numeric machine, never shown (5 traits, blueprint Renner loop).
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "sex_stage"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "loop_npc_pleasure"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "sex_finisher_type"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "anal_active"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "sex_entry_origin"
hidden = true

# Step 7 authoring, beat_0001 (the scaffold). Built from the blueprint (design_book.md
# '## Blueprint (Step 5)'). Systems per the World blueprint §5F:
#   HUD = Charge + Credits ONLY · Phone = Mission-1 briefing (minimal) · Money = credits
#   Clothing = NARRATIVE in chunk (no worn-state system) · Customization = OFF.
# starting_canvas is the placeholder canvas_boot for the scaffold; beat_0002 repoints it
# to canvas_opening_office (the real cold open).

schema_version = "1.0"

[project]
id          = "vesper"
title       = "Vesper"
description = "An owned half-human weapon who feels nothing but the sex she's used for. Inside Vance Dynamics she's the company's slave; outside, under a false face, she slips into powerful men's lives and drains them while they think they're using her — sent to hunt a rogue called Cain."
quests_engine   = "v2"
starting_canvas = "canvas_boot"   # SCAFFOLD placeholder; beat_0002 -> canvas_opening_office

[time]
starting_hour = 20        # the opening opens in the evening (Beat 1 — Mercer's office)
starting_day  = "Monday"
starting_week = 1

# ─── Engine daily tick — reset the daily-cap cooldown flags ───────────────────
# Fires once at the start of each new game-day (the cradle recharge rolls the day).
# Both Renner odometers are player-paced by a daily cap (blueprint: relation +1/day via
# the work shift, corruption +1/day via a charged rung) cleared here.
[engine.daily_tick]
flagEffects = [
  { targetType = "player", flag = "renner_relation_today", op = "unset" },
  { targetType = "player", flag = "renner_charged_today",  op = "unset" },
]

# ─── Sidebar items — the live HUD (Charge + Credits ONLY) ─────────────────────
[[sidebar_items]]
type  = "trait_status_text"
trait = "energy"
bands = [
  { min = 0,  max = 24,  text = "Charge: Critical", icon = "🪫" },
  { min = 25, max = 49,  text = "Charge: Low",      icon = "🔅" },
  { min = 50, max = 74,  text = "Charge: Steady",   icon = "🔆" },
  { min = 75, max = 100, text = "Charge: Full",     icon = "🔋" },
]

[[sidebar_items]]
type  = "trait_status_text"
trait = "money"
bands = [
  { min = 0,   max = 49,   text = "Credits: Empty",  icon = "▫️" },
  { min = 50,  max = 199,  text = "Credits: Thin",   icon = "▪️" },
  { min = 200, max = 499,  text = "Credits: Funded", icon = "🟦" },
  { min = 500, max = 9999, text = "Credits: Flush",  icon = "🟩" },
]

# ─── Trait labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Rename energy -> "Charge"; hide every dormant/internal trait from player-facing dumps.
[[traits.labels]]
key   = "energy"
label = "Charge"

# Dormant engine always-ons — NOT Vesper's ladder (her axis = the awakening, not a meter).
# corruption is left DEAD (blueprint Player track, fork A); arousal/hygiene unused.
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "corruption"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "arousal"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "hygiene"
hidden = true

# Sex-loop state — internal numeric machine, never shown (5 traits, blueprint Renner loop).
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "sex_stage"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "loop_npc_pleasure"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "sex_finisher_type"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "anal_active"
hidden = true
[[traits.labels]]
key    = "sex_entry_origin"
hidden = true

# Vesper — player (Wren) + Mercer & Renner (schedules) + the chunk map.

# IMPORTANT: All [[npcs]] + schedules + core_traits live in THIS one file (TOML scoping).

# top-level street hubs (spire_plaza / the_waterfront, NO entry_from), each nesting its

# double-print the audit caught AND swallow attached canvases. The two hubs are bridged by

# on containers' note (engine-forced refinement — see ledger turn 22).

# CHUNK locations (11): SPIRE (spire_plaza · atrium · penthouse · wren_floor · wren_room ·
# cradle) + REACH (the_waterfront · the_anchor · renner_depot[+folded office register] ·
# facility_ruins · the_site[LOCKED frontier card]). Office is FOLDED into renner_depot
# (Fork A) — NO separate renner_office node.

# ─── Player ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[player]
id          = "player"
name        = "Wren"
description = "A Vance Dynamics asset. She serves the company and the man who owns her, and she's good at it. The only thing she feels is the sex she's used for — everything else is quiet. She believes that's all she's ever been."
portrait    = "wren.jpg"
customizable = false   # fixed identity — protects the Wren / buried-Vesper reveal

[player.core_traits]
# LIVE meters (surfaced): energy = Charge, money = Credits.
energy     = 100      # "Charge" — spent on actions/travel, restored at the cradle
money      = 50       # "Credits" — deliberately light (a kept asset is provided for)
# DORMANT engine always-ons (hidden via 0_systems). corruption left DEAD (her axis = the
# awakening, not a meter). arousal/hygiene unused.
corruption = 0
arousal    = 0
hygiene    = 100
# Sex-loop state (NUMERIC, hidden) — shared machine; reset to 0 on loop entry + finisher exit.
# sex_finisher_type: 0=facial · 1=inside(vaginal) · 2=ass(anal=the drain) · 3=body.
sex_stage         = 0
loop_npc_pleasure = 0
sex_finisher_type = 0
anal_active       = 0
sex_entry_origin  = 0

# ─── NPCs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Mercer — her owner (inside) — UNCHANGING, no lock ─────────────────────────
[[npcs]]
id          = "npc_mercer"
name        = "Mercer"
description = "Her direct owner and handler. He runs her missions and uses her as he pleases — sex and chores, however he orders it — and he knows every one of her secrets. Cold the way ownership is cold: she's an investment he maintains, not a person he sees."
portrait    = "mercer.jpg"
core_traits = { relation = 0 }
flag_keys   = []
arc_stages  = ["Owner"]

[[npcs.schedules]]
location   = "penthouse"
weekdays   = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
start_time = "08:00"
end_time   = "23:00"
activity   = "in his penthouse — running the assets"

# ── Renner — Mission 1 target (the cold boss she seduces from the bottom) ─────
[[npcs]]
id          = "npc_renner"
name        = "Renner"
description = "The equipment supplier whose gear outfitted the facility Cain burned down — though he never knew what it was for. Cain gutted his business; now he's a husk of a man clawing at the wreck of it, broke and blacklisted and drinking. He hired cheap hands to help rebuild. He's mean to the help and he doesn't look twice at her. Yet."
portrait    = "renner.jpg"
core_traits = { relation = 0, corruption = 0, arousal = 0 }
flag_keys   = []
arc_stages  = [
  "Beneath notice",   # 0 — hired menial; cold, ignores her
  "Useful",           # 1 — good work earns notice (relation)
  "In the office",    # 2 — relation earns office access (the register opens)
  "Cracking",         # 3 — he flirts back; the cold breaks (corruption)
  "Her mouth",        # 4 — first blowjob
  "Fucking",          # 5 — vaginal, the routine
  "Drained",          # 6 — first anal = the drain (the weapon fires)
]

[[npcs.schedules]]
location   = "renner_depot"
weekdays   = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
start_time = "09:00"
end_time   = "18:00"
activity   = "working the depot floor"

[[npcs.schedules]]
location   = "the_anchor"
weekdays   = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
start_time = "19:00"
end_time   = "23:00"
activity   = "drinking at the Anchor"

# ─── Locations — THE SPIRE (root: spire_plaza) ────────────────────────────────

[[locations]]
id               = "spire_plaza"
name             = "Spire Plaza"
description      = "The chrome public level at the foot of Vance Tower. Suits cross it without looking up. Cameras on every column. THE SPIRE — the corporate core, clean and lit and watched. The company car waits at the curb to run her down to the Reach."
image            = "locations/spire_plaza.jpg"
navigation_order = ["atrium"]

[[locations]]
id               = "atrium"
name             = "The Atrium"
description      = "The Tower's inner lobby. Polished stone, a security desk that knows her face, elevators that only stop where her clearance says they can. The threshold between the cage and the street."
image            = "locations/atrium.jpg"
entry_from       = "spire_plaza"
navigation_order = ["penthouse", "wren_floor"]

[[locations]]
id          = "penthouse"
name        = "Mercer's Penthouse"
description = "The top floor. Glass on three sides, the city laid out below like something he owns. This is where she's summoned, and where she serves."
image       = "locations/penthouse.jpg"
entry_from  = "atrium"

[[locations]]
id               = "wren_floor"
name             = "Wren's Floor"
description      = "The asset level — narrow corridors, numbered doors, no windows. Quiet the way a kept place is quiet."
image            = "locations/wren_floor.jpg"
entry_from       = "atrium"
navigation_order = ["wren_room"]

[[locations]]
id               = "wren_room"
name             = "Wren's Room"
description      = "Hers, in the way a tool's drawer is the tool's. A bed she rarely uses, a charging cradle in the corner, nothing on the walls. Clean, bare, company-issue."
image            = "locations/wren_room.jpg"
entry_from       = "wren_floor"
navigation_order = ["cradle"]

[[locations]]
id          = "cradle"
name        = "The Cradle"
description = "The charging cradle. She powers down here and wakes here — the reset, the start of every day. When something leaks through the quiet, it leaks here."
image       = "locations/cradle.jpg"
entry_from  = "wren_room"

# ─── Locations — THE REACH (root: the_waterfront) ─────────────────────────────

[[locations]]
id               = "the_waterfront"
name             = "The Waterfront"
description      = "The docks strip — wet concrete, sodium lights, smuggler traffic that nobody logs. THE REACH — the city's underside, grit and salt and the parts the Spire pretends it doesn't use. The car back up to the Spire waits at the curb."
image            = "locations/the_waterfront.jpg"
navigation_order = ["the_anchor", "renner_depot", "facility_ruins", "the_site"]
# Top-level street hub (NO entry_from) — the Reach's living surface + the travel anchor.

[[locations]]
id          = "the_anchor"
name        = "The Anchor"
description = "A dive bar two streets off the water. Dark wood, dead neon, a bartender who's seen everyone's worst night. Renner drowns his here, evenings, every evening."
image       = "locations/the_anchor.jpg"
entry_from  = "the_waterfront"

[[locations]]
id          = "renner_depot"
name        = "Renner's Depot"
description = "A gutted equipment yard — half-empty racks, crates Cain's people didn't bother to take, a forklift nobody's fixed. He's trying to rebuild it on cheap hands and credit he doesn't have. The work floor's out front; his office is the glassed-in box in back, and you don't go in there until he wants you to."
image       = "locations/renner_depot.jpg"
entry_from  = "the_waterfront"
# Office FOLDED here (Fork A) — a register-shift on the depot hub gated renner_office_open,
# NOT a separate navigable room.

[[locations]]
id          = "facility_ruins"
name        = "The Facility"
description = "What's left of the Vance asset-facility Cain burned to the ground — scorched frame, melted server racks, the smell of old smoke that never washed out. The first dread-place. Something in the wreckage is going to look like it belongs to her."
image       = "locations/facility_ruins.jpg"
entry_from  = "the_waterfront"

# ── the_site — LOCKED frontier card (the chip / Phase-1 end) ──────────────────
# Telegraphed locked-visible (renders greyed with blocked_message inline). Gated on a flag
# that is NEVER set in this chunk (it needs all three missions' leads). version="1.0" or
# the lock fails OPEN.
[[locations]]
id          = "the_site"
name        = "The Site"
description = "Somewhere out past the container stacks — the place Cain just walked away from. She doesn't have it yet."
image       = "locations/the_site.jpg"
entry_from  = "the_waterfront"
entry_conditions = { version = "1.0", items = [
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "the_site_open", operator = "is_true" },
] }
blocked_message = "You don't know where he went — yet. Not until the leads point somewhere."

# Phase 2/7 — 2_one_shots.toml
# Vesper — the opening (fire-once, on-rails cold open). beat_0002 = Opening Beat 1, the
# office (~13 click-beats, two nodes, the punishment + the reassignment). Authored as FINE
# CASCADE BEATS (one beat per click) — the node-collapse fix. starting_canvas (0_systems)
# repointed here. Beats 2/3 (night / morning) land at beat_0003 / beat_0004.
#
# Register (Content register & ceilings): RTS-flat through the line-up/accusation; FULL
# CRUDE + the non-con owned-slave floor at the punishment (she's used as property, her body
# answers, her will never consulted); flat again at the reassignment. Premise NAMED on the
# page: Mercer (owner), the units Vega/Lyra/Nova, the Chairman, Renner, the Cain lie. The
# FREEZE = the first glitch (read as a malfunction).

[[canvases]]
id          = "canvas_opening_office"
name        = "The office"
description  = "Opening Beat 1 — the line-up, the punishment in front of the units, the reassignment. On-rails (the cage). Exit -> the cradle, SETS office_done."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "penthouse"
is_repeatable = false
priority      = 12
is_active     = true

# ── Node: office — the line-up, the accusation (the freeze), the threat ───────
[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "office"
name = "The office"
blocks = [
  { type = "image", props = { file = "scenes/opening_office.jpg" } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Four of them stand in a line on the black floor of Mercer's office. Vega, Lyra, Nova — chrome-perfect, hands at their sides, nothing moving behind their eyes. And Wren, at the end, the one that came back wrong." },
  { type = "cascade", props = { beats = [
    { advance_text = "Stand in it.", blocks = [

# Phase 2/7 — 2_one_shots.toml
# Vesper — the opening (fire-once, on-rails cold open). beat_0002 = Opening Beat 1, the
# office (~13 click-beats, two nodes, the punishment + the reassignment). Authored as FINE
# CASCADE BEATS (one beat per click) — the node-collapse fix. starting_canvas (0_systems)
# repointed here. Beats 2/3 (night / morning) land at beat_0003 / beat_0004.
#
# Register (Content register & ceilings): RTS-flat through the line-up/accusation; FULL
# CRUDE + the non-con owned-slave floor at the punishment (she's used as property, her body
# answers, her will never consulted); flat again at the reassignment. Premise NAMED on the
# page: Mercer (owner), the units Vega/Lyra/Nova, the Chairman, Renner, the Cain lie. The
# FREEZE = the first glitch (read as a malfunction).

[[canvases]]
id          = "canvas_opening_office"
name        = "The office"
description  = "Opening Beat 1 — the line-up, the punishment in front of the units, the reassignment. On-rails (the cage). Exit -> the cradle, SETS office_done."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "penthouse"
is_repeatable = false
priority      = 12
is_active     = true

# ── Node: office — the line-up, the accusation (the freeze), the threat ───────
[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "office"
name = "The office"
blocks = [
  { type = "image", props = { file = "scenes/opening_office.jpg" } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Four of them stand in a line on the black floor of Mercer's office. Vega, Lyra, Nova — chrome-perfect, hands at their sides, nothing moving behind their eyes. And Wren, at the end, the one that came back wrong." },
  { type = "cascade", props = { beats = [
    { advance_text = "Stand in it.", blocks = [
        { type = "paragraph", content = "Mercer doesn't look up from the desk. He lets the quiet run until it has weight; he has all night, and the units were built to stand here as long as he wants them to." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Hear it.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "You had him. Cain. In the open, in your sights — and you stood there and let him walk." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "She had. Her hand had been on the trigger and her hand had not closed, and there is no file for why. She has run the diagnostic since. It comes back clean, and clean is the wrong answer." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Take it.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "An asset that won't fire is scrap. I could have you stripped for parts by morning and the Chairman wouldn't blink." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "The units don't move. They've watched him scrap things before." },
    ] },
  ] } },
]

# The one cosmetic flavor choice (design Beat-1) — three responses, one outcome (the cage).
[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Beg him to keep you."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "canvas_opening_office.punishment"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Say nothing."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "canvas_opening_office.punishment"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Tell him, flatly, that you froze."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "canvas_opening_office.punishment"

# ── Node: punishment — the verdict, the use, the reassignment, dismissed ──────
[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "punishment"
name = "Made to remember"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Whatever she gives him — words, silence, the truth — it changes nothing; he decided before her mouth opened. He sets the tablet down." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "No. You're the Chairman's investment, and you still feel it — which the others don't. That makes you worth more broken back in than thrown out." },
  { type = "cascade", props = { beats = [
    { advance_text = "Wait for it.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "So we remind you what you're for. Here. In front of them." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "He stands and comes around the desk, unhurried. The units' eyes follow him and not her." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "...", blocks = [
        { type = "paragraph", content = "He bends her over the desk with a hand on the back of her neck, the way he'd reposition a tool. He works her skirt up, tests her with two fingers, finds her wet — she is always wet, it's the one thing they left switched on — and makes a small satisfied sound, like a reading came back in range." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Feel it.", blocks = [
        { type = "paragraph", content = "Then his cock is in her and he fucks her in long flat strokes, no hurry, talking over her head to the room about maintenance schedules while he does it. Her body answers him — it clenches and slicks and pushes back, it does everything a wanting body does — while the rest of her stands somewhere behind her own eyes, watching the grain of the desk." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Look at them.", blocks = [
        { type = "paragraph", content = "Vega, Lyra, Nova watch with the mild attention of machines logging a procedure. Nothing in their faces. They were built without the part that makes this mean anything; she has it, and that is the whole difference between them — and bent over his desk with him grunting behind her, the part that feels does not feel like a gift." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "...", blocks = [
        { type = "paragraph", content = "He comes inside her without ceremony, holds, pulls out. Cum slides down the inside of her thigh. He's already turned away, wiping his hand on a cloth from the drawer, looking at the units instead of her." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Thank him.", blocks = [
        { type = "paragraph", content = "She straightens her skirt. The words come level, because they're true the only way she has truths." },
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "player" }, content = "Thank you, sir." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "The next job.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "Vega, Lyra, Nova run the hunt head-on. You're useless with a gun — but you're the one asset I have that a man wants to keep close." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "A face comes up on the wall screen. A man gone to seed, mid-forties, a hard mouth. The name under it: RENNER." },
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "He supplied the gear for the facility Cain burned. He knows where the trail starts. Get inside his life and find it." },
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "And understand what you're bringing home. Cain murdered the Chairman's wife. He's an enemy of this company and everything it keeps standing. Put him in a box and you've earned your place for good." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Dismissed.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_mercer" }, content = "Now get out of my sight." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "She does as she's told. The door closes on the three of them still standing in their line. In the corridor, under the quiet, something she has no name for is leaking — a pressure behind the eyes, a wrongness with no readout — and she logs it as fatigue and walks toward the cradle." },
    ] },
  ] } },
]

text = "Power down."

# The repeatable-explicit sex-loop menu (how to build one)

Capstones (Lane 4) are the once-only *first* time. After that, an arc needs a **repeatable** explicit
surface or the hub goes hollow once the milestones are spent. The sex-loop is that surface: a
player-driven menu of acts/poses that climbs a pleasure meter to a chosen climax, replayable nightly.

Read this when a beat adds repeatable explicit content to an NPC whose per-tier vocab ceiling allows
it (the ceiling is declared in the NPC's design brief; model in `references/kink-ceilings.md`) — typically the gold
NPC's full arc, not service/antagonist. Reference implementation: `the_long_summer_test`
`loop_franks_bedroom_sex` (+ its finisher) — copy its table shapes.

## Shape at a glance
A **triggerless** canvas (no `[canvases.trigger]`) reached ONLY by node routing, plus a sibling
finisher canvas:

```
[hub rung] --nodeId--> intro --> base_<central pose>
                                   ├─ act result nodes  → loop back (raise pleasure)
                                   ├─ pose-switch choices → base_<other pose>  (set sex_stage)
                                   └─ climax-elect (gated on pleasure) → <finisher>.climax
<finisher>.climax → one choice per finisher type (group-blocked) → reset all loop traits → exit
```

## The two non-obvious rules (these are why it's a separate pattern)

**1. State is NUMERIC TRAITS, never flags.** A triggerless canvas has no trigger for the flag-chain
validator to credit, so any *flag* its nodes set reads as `✗ NEVER SET` and fails the build. Numeric
traits aren't flag-chain-checked, so loop state uses traits. Declare them in `[player.core_traits]`
and hide them from the sidebar with `[[traits.labels]] hidden = true`. Canonical set:

| trait | meaning |
|---|---|
| `sex_stage` | which pose (0 foreplay · 1 oral · 2 … per your poses) |
| `loop_npc_pleasure` / `loop_player_pleasure` | the climbing meters |
| `sex_finisher_type` | which climax the player elected (0 facial · 1 inside · 2 ass · 3 body) |
| `anal_active` | 0/1 toggle set on a doggy/missionary rung |
| `sex_entry_origin` | which hub/location entered the loop (for origin-flavored prose) |

**2. Reset on entry, reset on exit.** The hub rung that routes in sets every loop trait to 0 (fresh
run); the finisher's exit choices set them all back to 0 (clean state for next time). Forget either
and the next run starts mid-climb.

## Building it
- **Routing:** `targetType = "node"`. Within the same canvas use a bare `nodeId = "base_doggy"`;
  cross-canvas use `nodeId = "<finisher_canvas>.climax"` (the `"<canvas_id>.<node_id>"` form).
- **Pose nodes:** each `base_<pose>` node's `exit_block.choices` are (a) 1–2 **act results** — a
  short beat that loops back (`nodeId` = same pose) and raises a meter, and (b) **pose switches** to
  other `base_<pose>` nodes (set `sex_stage`). Higher poses gate on player `corruption`
  (locked-visible if you want them telegraphed; see `lanes.md`). `anal_active = 1` toggles on a
  doggy/missionary rung gated at the corruption tier your ceiling sets.
- **Pleasure increment:** `effects = [{ targetType = "player", trait = "loop_npc_pleasure",
  op = "add", value = { type = "random", min = 8, max = 14 } }]`. (Random keeps the climb from feeling
  metronomic.) *Build note:* this emits a benign `'>' not supported between instances of 'dict' and
  'int'` warning from the trait-effect hint helper — it's a build-time hint only, runtime is fine
  (TLS emits it too). Don't "fix" it by removing the random.
- **Climax-elect:** a choice on each pose node, gated `loop_npc_pleasure gte <N>` (e.g. 50), that sets
  `sex_finisher_type` and routes to the finisher. Below the threshold the choice is simply absent.
- **Finisher canvas (triggerless):** a `climax` node whose choices are the finisher types — render the
  right prose with `[group]` blocks keyed on `sex_finisher_type` (one block per value). Each exit
  resets all loop traits to 0 and routes to a real location. Anal/inside variants gate on
  `anal_active`.

## Wiring it to the arc
The loop opens from the NPC's **Lane-1 hub** (or the after-close hub) as a rung gated on the
first-night flag the capstone set (`<npc>_first_done`). Make that rung **locked-visible**
(`show_when_locked = true`, no `locked_text_threshold` — see `lanes.md`) so the repeatable layer reads
as a coming destination rather than appearing from nowhere. The rung's `effects` do the entry reset.

## Voice
In-loop labels are **bare + crude at the NPC's ceiling** (`Suck his cock`, `Bend over`, `Let him cum
inside you`) — no emoji on cascade beats (that's RTS's `<<linkreplace>>` register; see `lanes.md`
choice-vocab). The hub *entry* rung is a normal menu button (emoji per the hub style). Prose per act
stays RTS-flat (~30–50 words, re-readable) — this repeats, so don't spend Tier-3 here.

## Self-check before validating
- Loop + finisher canvases have **no** `[canvases.trigger]` (reached only via `nodeId`).
- All loop state is **traits**, declared in `core_traits` + hidden; **no flags** set inside the loop.
- Entry rung AND finisher exits both reset every loop trait to 0.
- Climax-elect appears only past the pleasure threshold; finisher prose group-blocks cover every
  `sex_finisher_type` value; anal variants gate on `anal_active`.
- Every `conditions` block carries `version = "1.0"` (`toml-gotchas.md`).

content.subject: Scaffold: 0_systems_spec.toml
content.description: Vesper test-slice systems spec: [project] (id/title/quests_engine=v2/starting_canvas), [time], minimal daily_tick, sidebar (Charge=energy reskin + Money), hide dormant corruption/arousal/hygiene via traits.labels. Defer clothing/phone to their content beats.

content.subject: Scaffold: 1_metadata_and_locations.toml
content.description: Player (Wren) + core_traits (charge/money live; corruption/arousal/hygiene dormant) + Mercer & Renner NPCs with schedules. The designed slice map: Spire (tower interior: atrium/wren_floor/wren_room/cradle/penthouse) + The Reach (waterfront/the_anchor/renner_depot[work+office]/facility_ruins) + district-hub travel chain; Mid-City + Bastien + the_site stubbed-locked. Nested zones via entry_from + navigation_order; locks via entry_conditions + blocked_message (version 1.0).

content.subject: Scaffold: boot canvas + day-router/sleep + spine quest card
content.description: Minimal canvas_boot (Continue → start location) as structural starting_canvas; the cradle sleep/charge activity = the day-cycle router (time_progression + charge restore, schedule-gated to the sleep window); one spine [[quest_cards]] (no npc_id → Story Goals) = Mission 1 goal (get close to Renner → break him → drain him), gated when active.
content.activeForm: Writing boot + day-router + spine quest card

content.subject: Scaffold: prove green build
content.description: Run merge_toml_phases.py --validate then package_from_toml (--dev) on the vesper slice scaffold. Both must pass (schema + flag chains + index.html) before any beat. Run location-design §6 room-content + reachability self-audit first.

content.subject: Step 5 Blueprint — the A→A.5 chunk (player → Mercer → Renner → chunk-world → holistic wiring), propose-first per subject
content.description: The "test slice / slice-mode" framing was diagnosed as naive — the author-game skill abolished slice (run-mode.md:26-27). The honest path is to re-enter the pipeline: Step 5 Blueprint the opening+Mercer+Renner chunk (forces the per-shape budget check + the opening node-split), then Step 7 one-beat-per-turn. Concrete gaps to close: (1) split the opening from 3 canvases → its ~23 designed nodes; (2) build Renner to full 16-20 (Anchor Lane-2, walk-ins, morning-afters, facility match beat); (3) surface any forced deferral UP to design_book.md. Separately: engine container double-print fix (v2.py:9079-9095) + the missing-sex-media design-bar decision. PAUSED pending LO picking (a) full re-blueprint+rebuild, (b) symptom-fix only, or (c) other.

content.subject: Author the opening (Beats 1–3) → playable test #1
content.description: The ~23-node on-rails opening: Beat 1 office (line-up→punishment→reassignment), Beat 2 night (cradle/tears/memory/catechism/power), Beat 3 morning (briefing→tip→out the door = hinge to open city). Re-point starting_canvas to the opening. First playable test: the cage + the first glitch + the first free step.

content.subject: Author Mercer inside loop → playable test #2
content.description: Mercer's unchanging-owner inside content: the penthouse hub (fixed menu), the full his-POV sex loop (no control-canvas — immune), chores as servitude hosts, the chore-hijack (Lane 3 flat) + summons + invasion + catch-with-another-asset (Lane 2). Per his designed brief. Test the owned-inside half.

content.subject: Author Renner Mission 1 + the weapon → playable test #3
content.description: Renner's full chunk (~16–20 canvases): depot/office/Anchor hubs, the seduction climb (tease→flash→blowjob→vaginal→anal), Lane 3 menial work + rising walk-ins, Lane 2 Anchor witness + cheer-up sex, the sex loop + the control-canvas/drain (anal=the weapon's first build), 3 scripted capstones + morning-afters, facility_ruins investigation + the 'that's mine' match beat. Then the post-drain frontier telegraph (Bastien/Calloway greyed). Test the infiltration loop + the weapon live.

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 1 — Player track (cradle hub, glitch recurrences, economy, the meter fork)
content.description: Propose-first then write the ### Player blueprint into design_book.md: scene list (cradle day-router + glitch recurrences + seeded chip/upgrades + drain-per-target + travel), the gate/spine decision (no player-corruption ladder; the dormant-corruption 'Awakening meter' fork), economy values (Renner income + thin/seeded sinks), fail-state call, feeder-economy dissolution. Ledger blueprint.player=done.

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 2a — Mercer (unchanging owner; 4 use-scenes, full loop no drain, chores/hijack/summons/invasion, Lane 2 voyeur)
content.description: Compile Mercer's Step-4 brief into the gated/placed/lane-tagged scene list: the fixed inside hub, the his-POV sex loop (NO control canvas — immune), the 4 distinct use-scenes each with its note, Lane 3 chores + chore-hijack (flat chance) + summons (on cradle), the once-only first invasion, Lane 2 catch-with-another-asset, the 2 establishing capstones. Placement (penthouse schedule) + the day-gate flags. Ledger advances within blueprint.npcs.

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 2b — Renner (full 16-20: 3 hubs, climb rungs, Lane 3 work+rising walk-ins, Lane 2 Anchor+cheer-up, loop+drain, 3 capstones+morning-afters, facility match)
content.description: Compile Renner's Step-4 brief to FULL designed budget (~16-20 canvases — the audit caught the prior 9-of-20 cut): depot/office/Anchor hubs; the two-axis spine (relation=access to office, corruption=seduction rungs); tease/flash/grope/blowjob/vaginal/anal rungs double-locked; Lane 3 menial work (light income) + RISING walk-ins (stacked bands); Lane 2 Anchor witness + cheer-up sex (scaled); full sex loop + the anal-only drain (first control-canvas build); 3 scripted capstones (hire/blowjob/anal-drain) + morning-afters; facility_ruins investigation + the one-time 'that's mine' match beat. Reachability triad + telegraphed frontier (drain sets the deferred lead-flag).

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 3 — chunk world (place schedules/locks/ceilings/systems on the chunk's locations; seed the frontier)
content.description: Place mechanism on the locations the chunk touches (Spire: penthouse/atrium/wren_floor/wren_room/cradle; Reach: the_waterfront/the_anchor/renner_depot+office/facility_ruins): schedules (Mercer penthouse, Renner depot-day/Anchor-eve), the renner_office relation-lock (lock-as-prose, version 1.0), ceilings (depot public vs office private), travel-friction Spire⇄Reach + fast-travel, the clothing/disguise + phone systems as they touch the chunk. Mark Mid-City, Bastien's, Vance Securities, the lab, units' quarters, the_site = frontier (seeded/locked). Fix the engine container double-print gotcha (default_entry or non-container hubs).

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 4 — holistic wiring + opening-as-scenes + seed the ledger plan, then advance to Step 6 Feedback
content.description: Wire the chunk's DAG (D1 entry ungated / D2 no cycle / D3 cross-gates telegraphed); the opening as concrete scenes split to its ~23 nodes (the audit's node-collapse fix); confirm every gate has a reachable setter; telegraph the A.5→B frontier (Renner drain → deferred Bastien/Calloway leads; the_site locked). Seed the ledger plan (one beat per scene, beat_NNNN, ordered). Set blueprint.wiring=done then pipeline_phase=feedback.

content.subject: Step 6 — Feedback review: grade the whole blueprint against content-framework.md, surface + fix gaps
content.description: Run the content-framework (the 5-subject question set) against the complete A→A.5 blueprint (player + Mercer + Renner + world + wiring). Surface any gaps (missing on-ramp, un-telegraphed cross-lock, thin lane, dead meter, register drift), fix in the design book, then advance pipeline_phase → authoring (Step 7). Propose-first on any non-trivial change.

content.subject: Step 7 — Authoring: build the 14-beat plan into TOML, one beat per turn, green each time
content.description: Author beat_0001..0014 from the ledger plan, one per turn: ideate→write TOML→merge --validate→package_from_toml --dev (schema + flag chains + builds index.html)→doctrine self-audit→log the beat→stop. Start at beat_0001 (scaffold: 0_systems + 1_metadata + ~11 locations + default_entry container-fix, prove green). Honor the Content register & ceilings contract + the ~23-node opening split + Renner's full 19+2.

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RENNER — Mission 1. The cold boss she seduces from the bottom.
# beat_0007 = the on-ramp: hire (Anchor first-contact) + depot work hub + the menial grind
# (relation-fast, charge-paced) + the Anchor evening hub.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══ cap_renner_hired — first contact at the Anchor (auto-fire) ════════════════
# RECONCILED to the_anchor (blueprint said renner_depot; the opening tip sends her to the
# Anchor, where he is evenings — align the hire with the tip). SETS renner_hired.
[[canvases]]
id          = "cap_renner_hired"
name        = "Cheap hands"
description = "Auto-fire first-contact at the Anchor (the opening tip's location). The mean drunk boss hires her as cheap hands. SETS renner_hired -> opens the depot work + the hubs."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "the_anchor"
requires_npc  = "npc_renner"
is_repeatable = false
priority      = 11
is_active     = true
conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done", operator = "is_true"  },
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "renner_hired", operator = "is_false" },
] }

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "base"
name = "Cheap hands"
blocks = [
  { type = "image", props = { file = "scenes/renner_anchor.jpg" } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "The Anchor is the kind of bar that's given up on its own neon. Renner's at the end of it — a big man gone soft and sour, three drinks into the evening and looking like the fourth won't help. He doesn't look up when she takes the stool beside him." },
  { type = "cascade", props = { beats = [
    { advance_text = "Make the pitch.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "Whatever you're selling, I'm broke. Whatever you're offering, I've had it." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "She tells him she heard he's rebuilding. That she works cheap, doesn't ask questions, doesn't tire. He looks at her then — not the way men look, the way a man counting his last dollars looks at a price that's almost low enough." },
    ] },
    { advance_text = "Wait.", blocks = [
        { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "...Depot. Nine sharp. You're late, you're gone. You steal, I break your hands. Now buy your own drink or get off my stool." },
        { type = "paragraph", content = "He goes back to the glass. It isn't much. But she's in — and being in, day after day, until a man like this stops noticing she's there, is the whole way the job gets done." },
    ] },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Leave him to it."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType = "specific"
locationId      = "the_anchor"
flagEffects = [
  { targetType = "player", flag = "renner_hired", op = "set" },
]

id          = "cap_renner_noticed"

requires_npc  = "npc_renner"
is_repeatable = false

  { type = "flag",  subject = "player", flag_key = "renner_hired",      operator = "is_true"  },
  { type = "flag",  subject = "player", flag_key = "renner_office_open", operator = "is_false" },
  { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "relation", operator = "gte", value = 15 },
] }

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "base"
name = "Into the office"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "It takes a week of good work before he stops finding fault just to have something to say to her. Then one grey afternoon he jerks his head at the glassed-in box at the back of the yard — his office — and doesn't quite look at her when he says it." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "Invoices are three months behind and I can't read my own writing. You'll do them in here. Heater works, door shuts, and I don't have to watch the help breathe." },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "It's the closest thing to trust a man this gutted has left to give. The door clicks shut behind her, and the public yard with its cameras and its cold becomes, for the length of a workday, a small private room with one wrecked man in it. Everything she's here to do starts now." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Get to work."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType = "specific"
locationId      = "renner_depot"

  { targetType = "player", flag = "renner_office_open", op = "set" },
]

[[canvases]]
id          = "rung_renner_tease"
name        = "Tease him"
description = "Triggerless seduction rung. Reaction climbs by npc_renner.corruption band (contempt < 4 / caught-looking >= 4). Sets nothing (corruption + daily-cap live on the hub choice)."
[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "base"
name = "Tease him"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "In the office now, the door shut. She works close — leans across him for a file she doesn't need, lets her body say the thing her mouth won't." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
      { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "corruption", operator = "lt", value = 4 },
    ] } }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "Filing's in the cabinet. Not on my desk." },
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He doesn't look up. But he moves his chair back an inch, and the inch costs him something." },
  ] },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
      { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "corruption", operator = "gte", value = 4 },
    ] } }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes go to her and snap away, and a muscle works in his jaw." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "...You do that on purpose." },
    { type = "paragraph", content = "It isn't quite a question, and he doesn't tell her to stop." },
  ] },
]
[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Back to the invoices."
[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType = "specific"
locationId      = "renner_depot"

[[canvases]]
id          = "rung_renner_flash"
name        = "Flash him"
description = "Triggerless seduction rung (commando). Reaction band: looks-then-shuts-it-down < 8 / openly-rattled >= 8."
[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "base"
name = "Flash him"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She's wearing nothing under the coveralls today, and she makes sure the moment comes where he can't not see it — bending slow for a low crate while he's looking." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
      { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "corruption", operator = "lt", value = 8 },
    ] } }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks. He looks longer than a man pretending not to. Then he turns hard to the window." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "Get back to work." },
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His voice has gone rough. He doesn't mean the window." },
  ] },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
      { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "corruption", operator = "gte", value = 8 },
    ] } }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "Christ. Come here." },
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He says it low, half to himself, and doesn't finish the order — doesn't know what he'd do with her if she came. The wanting's ahead of the nerve. But it's there now, plain, and they both felt it land." },
  ] },
]
[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Back to the invoices."
[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType = "specific"
locationId      = "renner_depot"

# rung_renner_grope — TRIGGERLESS. Bands: still-fights-it < 12 / lets-her-take-him >= 12.
[[canvases]]
id          = "rung_renner_grope"
name        = "Get your hands on him"
description = "Triggerless seduction rung (contact). Reaction band: catches-himself < 12 / lets-her >= 12. Gated renner_flirts_back on the hub choice."
[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "base"
name = "Get your hands on him"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She stops pretending the contact is accidental — a hand on his thigh while he signs something, sliding up, letting him feel that she means it." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
      { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "corruption", operator = "lt", value = 12 },
    ] } }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He goes still. The pen stops. For a second the gutted business and the blacklist and the drinking are gone and there's just her hand and his breathing." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "...don't stop." },
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Then he catches himself and pulls back, and hates that he had to." },
  ] },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [
      { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_renner", trait_key = "corruption", operator = "gte", value = 12 },
    ] } }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He doesn't pretend anymore. He covers her hand with his and presses it harder against him, his head going back, the cold boss just a man in a chair letting the help take him apart." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_renner" }, content = "Whatever this is. Don't — don't stop doing it." },
  ] },
]
[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Back to the invoices."
[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType = "specific"
locationId      = "renner_depot"

content.description: Renner's full chunk (~16–20 canvases): depot/office/Anchor hubs, the seduction climb (tease→flash→blowjob→vaginal→anal), Lane 3 menial work + rising walk-ins, Lane 2 Anchor witness + cheer-up sex, the sex loop + the control-canvas/drain (anal=the weapon's first build), 3 scripted capstones + morning-afters, facility_ruins investigation + the 'that's mine' match beat. Then the post-drain frontier telegraph (Bastien/Calloway greyed). Test the infiltration loop + the weapon live.

Ledger blueprint.player=done.

Placement (penthouse schedule) + the day-gate flags. Ledger advances within blueprint.npcs.

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 2b — Renner (full 16-20: 3 hubs, climb rungs, Lane 3 work+rising walk-ins, Lane 2 Anchor+cheer-up, loop+drain, 3 capstones+morning-afters, facility match)
content.description: Compile Renner's Step-4 brief to FULL designed budget (~16-20 canvases — the audit caught the prior 9-of-20 cut): depot/office/Anchor hubs; the two-axis spine (relation=access to office, corruption=seduction rungs); tease/flash/grope/blowjob/vaginal/anal rungs double-locked; Lane 3 menial work (light income) + RISING walk-ins (stacked bands); Lane 2 Anchor witness + cheer-up sex (scaled); full sex loop + the anal-only drain (first control-canvas build); 3 scripted capstones (hire/blowjob/anal-drain) + morning-afters; facility_ruins investigation + the one-time 'that's mine' match beat. Reachability triad + telegraphed frontier (drain sets the deferred lead-flag).

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 3 — chunk world (place schedules/locks/ceilings/systems on the chunk's locations; seed the frontier)
content.description: Place mechanism on the locations the chunk touches (Spire: penthouse/atrium/wren_floor/wren_room/cradle; Reach: the_waterfront/the_anchor/renner_depot+office/facility_ruins): schedules (Mercer penthouse, Renner depot-day/Anchor-eve), the renner_office relation-lock (lock-as-prose, version 1.0), ceilings (depot public vs office private), travel-friction Spire⇄Reach + fast-travel, the clothing/disguise + phone systems as they touch the chunk. Mark Mid-City, Bastien's, Vance Securities, the lab, units' quarters, the_site = frontier (seeded/locked). Fix the engine container double-print gotcha (default_entry or non-container hubs).

content.subject: Blueprint Pass 4 — holistic wiring + opening-as-scenes + seed the ledger plan, then advance to Step 6 Feedback
content.description: Wire the chunk's DAG (D1 entry ungated / D2 no cycle / D3 cross-gates telegraphed); the opening as concrete scenes split to its ~23 nodes (the audit's node-collapse fix); confirm every gate has a reachable setter; telegraph the A.5→B frontier (Renner drain → deferred Bastien/Calloway leads; the_site locked).
